summary: Fresh independent representative-browser verification of the public durable chat mirror passed after claim G000003. The browser observed the real public JSON thread fetch, rendered the expected durable HUMAN and WORKER messages with the worker result_ref traceable, and reproduced the same durable thread after reload on desktop and narrow viewports. No local-chat state, websocket, iframe, aggressive polling, obvious public secret, request error, console error, uncaught error, invented liveness or authority promotion was required. CURRENT was explicitly observed as PROJECTION_STALE, preserving the distinction between durable served history and liveness.
